item.title: Survivor in Lebanon mourns family killed in Israeli missile attack
item.description: NBC News correspondent and "Here's the Scoop" host Yasmin Vossoughian went to Tyre, Lebanon, among the hardest-hit cities in the war, and met with a survivor who was pulled from the rubble following an Israeli airstrike that killed his wife, daughter, two grandchildren and nephew, and destroyed their home.

item.title: Outrage after Israeli soldier seen striking Jesus statue in Lebanon
item.description: A photograph showing an Israeli soldier damaging a statue of Jesus Christ has sparked public outrage. NBC News’ Molly Hunter reports on the Israeli military’s response to the incident.
